difficulty_reason: Vanishing/cokernel bounds for RF of a bounded functor F on D_QCoh: part (2) is proved in full - E = Rlim E_n via lemma-nice-K-injective, RF(E) = Rlim RF(E_n), the Milnor short exact sequence for H^i(RF(E)), the truncation distinguished triangles H^{-n}(E)[n] -> E_n -> E_{n-1} with R^{i+n}F(H^{-n}E) = 0 for i+n >= N, the ML condition forcing R^1 lim = 0 and the system constant from n = N-i-1; part (3) reduces to (1)+(2) via tau-truncation.
